name: loggly-api-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server for Loggly /apiv2 APIs plus RDAP/GreyNoise/AbuseIPDB IP intelligence.

tools.name: connection_test
tools.title: Connection Test
tools.description: Validates Loggly credentials by creating a small search and returning the RSID.

tools.name: create_search
tools.title: Create Search
tools.description: Creates a Loggly search and returns its RSID metadata.

tools.name: get_events
tools.title: Get Events
tools.description: Retrieves event results for a previously-created RSID from /apiv2/events.

tools.name: search_and_get_events
tools.title: Search And Get Events
tools.description: Creates a search then fetches one page from legacy /apiv2/events using the returned RSID.

tools.name: count_events
tools.title: Count Events
tools.description: Calls /apiv2/events/count to return event count and optional volume.

tools.name: iterate_events_page
tools.title: Iterate Events Page
tools.description: Calls /apiv2/events/iterate with query parameters and returns the first page plus next URL.

tools.name: iterate_events_next
tools.title: Iterate Events Next
tools.description: Fetches the next page from /apiv2/events/iterate using the exact next URL returned by the previous page.

tools.name: volume_metrics
tools.title: Volume Metrics
tools.description: Calls /apiv2/volume-metrics to retrieve count/volume grouped or filtered by host/app/log type/tag.

tools.name: stats_query
tools.title: Stats Query
tools.description: Calls /apiv2/stats/<stat_type>/<field> for numeric field statistics.

tools.name: list_fields
tools.title: List Fields
tools.description: Calls /apiv2/fields/ to return parsed field names in the selected time range.

tools.name: field_facets
tools.title: Field Facets
tools.description: Calls /apiv2/fields/<field>/ to return terms and counts for a specific field.

tools.name: raw_api_call
tools.title: Raw API Call
tools.description: Makes a GET request to a Loggly API path. Useful while discovering exact endpoint behavior.

tools.name: search_logs
tools.title: Search Logs (Aggregated)
tools.description: Runs a query and returns an aggregated summary (totals, top hosts/paths/status codes/user agents, timeline, sample events) instead of raw events.

tools.name: traffic_by_ip
tools.title: Traffic By IP
tools.description: Aggregated traffic summary scoped to a single IP address.

tools.name: traffic_by_host
tools.title: Traffic By Host
tools.description: Aggregated traffic summary scoped to a single hostname.

tools.name: traffic_by_path
tools.title: Traffic By Path
tools.description: Aggregated traffic summary scoped to a single request path.

tools.name: group_by_ip
tools.title: Group By IP
tools.description: Facet counts by IP for a query/time range.

tools.name: group_by_path
tools.title: Group By Path
tools.description: Facet counts by path for a query/time range.

tools.name: group_by_user_agent
tools.title: Group By User Agent
tools.description: Facet counts by User-Agent for a query/time range.

tools.name: timeline
tools.title: Timeline
tools.description: Bucketed event counts over a time range for a query.

tools.name: sample_events
tools.title: Sample Events
tools.description: Returns a small number of representative events for a query.

tools.name: rdap_lookup
tools.title: RDAP Lookup
tools.description: Looks up IP ownership/network registration data via public RDAP (rdap.org).

tools.name: ip_reputation
tools.title: IP Reputation
tools.description: Checks GreyNoise and AbuseIPDB for an IP (requires API keys).

tools.name: get_ip_context
tools.title: Get IP Context
tools.description: Combines RDAP, GreyNoise/AbuseIPDB, and cross-account Loggly traffic into one normalized IP profile.
